episodes.name: Muddy Puddles
episodes.summary: It's raining and Peppa is sad because she can't play outside. When the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games - jumping in muddy puddles! When Mummy and Daddy Pig join in, things get very muddy indeed.

episodes.name: Mr. Dinosaur is Lost
episodes.summary: Mr Dinosaur is George's favourite toy. When Mr Dinosaur goes missing, George is distraught. Daddy Pig helps Peppa to become a detective and together they track down Mr Dinosaur, making George a very happy little piggy again.

episodes.name: Best Friend
episodes.summary: Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play. George wants to play too, but Peppa won't let him join in their games, which makes him sad. Later, when Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses they discover they need a patient. George is allowed to join them and is happy to play the patient.

episodes.name: Polly Parrot
episodes.summary: Peppa and George visit Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's house, and meet their new pet parrot, Polly, who repeats everything you say.

episodes.name: Hide and Seek
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are playing hide and seek. Peppa is very good at hiding but George is too easy to find so she doesn't want to play with him any more. So Daddy Pig helps hide.

episodes.name: The Playgroup
episodes.summary: George is going to Peppa's playgroup but Peppa doesn't want him to. It's her playgroup after all. When George arrives he's a hit with all her friends. They think he's 'brilliant!'

episodes.name: Mummy Pig at Work
episodes.summary: Mummy is busy working on her computer and Peppa wants to help. Mummy Pig takes a break and lets Peppa and George play on the computer, but they are not allowed to play games. Peppa and George try to play their computer game "Happy Mrs. Chicken" and the computer crashes. Luckily, Daddy can fix it.

episodes.name: Piggy in the Middle
episodes.summary: George can't catch the ball so Mummy suggests they play 'Piggy in the Middle' to help him learn. When Daddy Pig lifts George up, Peppa feels like the littlest piggy, but Mummy soon gives her a helping hand.

episodes.name: Daddy Loses His Glasses
episodes.summary: Daddy loses his glasses and is completely helpless without them. Peppa and George help him to look for them. They search everywhere but can't find them.

episodes.name: Gardening
episodes.summary: Peppa and George help Grandpa in the garden. Peppa and George are fascinated when Grandpa Pig tells them that everything grew from a tiny seed. Peppa and the others plant a strawberry tree, but it takes a long time for the seed to grow. George wants to grow something more unusual!

episodes.name: Hiccups
episodes.summary: George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups. Peppa thinks it's very funny at first, but when George's hiccups start to spoil their game, Peppa decides that she should cure him in her own special way.

episodes.name: Bicycles
episodes.summary: Peppa Pig and George decide it is a great day to go and ride bicycles while Daddy Pig is admiring a prize-winning pumpkin he has. Peppa's friends are all riding bicycles. When Peppa teases George about having a tricycle, the others point out that Peppa still needs stabilisers. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without them, however, Peppa accidentally smashes into the pumpkin!

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig makes Peppa box to put secret things in. George is sad because Peppa won't tell him what's in the box. When George gets his own box, and Peppa can't guess what's inside, she decides she doesn't like secrets much.

episodes.name: Flying a Kite
episodes.summary: Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy are flying a kite in the park. It gets tangled in a tree beside a big muddy puddle. Mummy Pig doesn't want George and Peppa to get muddy but when Daddy falls in, everyone gets splashed.

episodes.name: Picnic
episodes.summary: The Family go on a picnic. Peppa and George find a little pond and feed bread to the ducks. Mummy Pig's delicious strawberry cake attracts a wasp that chases Daddy Pig all around the picnic site.

episodes.name: Musical Instruments
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig find an old box full of musical instruments. Mummy plays the violin, Daddy plays the accordion and Peppa bangs the drum. But no one can play the Swiss horn.

episodes.name: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden. Peppa pretends to be a butterfly. Grandpa Pig shows George how to play at being a wriggly worm. Then they all have fun jumping in muddy puddles, pretending to be frogs.

episodes.name: Dressing Up
episodes.summary: Peppa and George love dressing up. One day they creep into Mummy and Daddy's room and dress up in their clothes. Peppa pretends to work at Mummy's computer and George does some digging in Daddy's vegetable garden.

episodes.name: New Shoes
episodes.summary: Peppa loses her shoes, but she gets new red ones, making her happy again. Peppa loses her shoes, so Mummy buys Peppa some new shiny, red shoes. Peppa loves her new shoes so much she never wants to take them off! After it rains, the family search for puddles to jump in. Peppa would love to join in but she is still wearing her new, shiny shoes.

episodes.name: The School Fete
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family go to the school fete. Peppa, George and their friends have their faces painted as tigers. All the children get a balloon and clever Daddy Pig impresses everyone when he makes a dinosaur shaped balloon.

episodes.name: Mummy Pig's Birthday
episodes.summary: It is Mummy Pig's birthday. Peppa, George and Daddy Pig are just as excited as Mummy. They have lots of fun preparing secret, birthday surprises for her. When Mummy Pig sees her beautiful cake and opens her present she is absolutely delighted.

episodes.name: The Tooth Fairy
episodes.summary: When Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy explains that the Tooth Fairy will come to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake and see the Tooth Fairy. But staying up is harder than she imagined.

episodes.name: The New Car
episodes.summary: The family's car breaks down and it has to go to the garage. While it's being fixed, they borrow a new one with lots of exciting buttons. One makes the roof go down, one makes the windows go up and one squirts Daddy in the face!

episodes.name: Treasure Hunt
episodes.summary: Granny and Grandpa organise a treasure hunt. Grandpa buries the treasure in a secret place in the garden and Peppa and George have to find it, using a map and following the clues. They have lots of fun looking for the treasure!

episodes.name: Not Very Well
episodes.summary: Peppa isn't feeling well and has red spots all over her face. Doctor Brown Bear pays a visit and says that Peppa will be fine, but she must stay in bed for a little while. The rash isn't catching, so her friends can come to visit!

episodes.name: Snow
episodes.summary: It is snowing today. Peppa and George must wear their hats and scarves and gloves. They have lots of fun playing in the snow, making footprints and throwing snowballs. Then they build a snowman, complete with hat and scarf and gloves.

episodes.name: Windy Castle
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family go on a day trip to Windy Castle. There's a wonderful view from the top. Peppa and George look through a telescope and can even see Granny and Grandpa Pig's house in the distance!

episodes.name: My Cousin Chloé
episodes.summary: Peppa's older cousin Chloé comes to visit. Peppa and George have been playing games and Peppa has been teasing George by making up the rules as she goes along. But now Chloé is here, Peppa has to play by someone else's rules for a change.

episodes.name: Pancakes
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig is making everyone pancakes. George and Peppa gobble theirs up noisily. Daddy Pig thinks that he's a bit of an expert at pancake flipping but he flips his pancake so high that it sticks to the kitchen ceiling! Can the family get it down?

episodes.name: Babysitting
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out so Granny and Grandpa Pig are baby-sitting. Peppa and George are put to bed but are too excited to sleep. Everyone has such fun that they exhaust themselves.

episodes.name: Ballet Lesson
episodes.summary: Peppa is excited about her very first ballet lesson and decides to teach Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and George how to dance. She is surprised to learn that Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig know a few ballet moves of their own.

episodes.name: Thunderstorm
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder! Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa decides that she loves thunderstorms. They make big, muddy puddles!

episodes.name: Cleaning the Car
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy. Mummy Pig insists that they clean the car first. Peppa and George help but it turns out to be a very messy job indeed.

episodes.name: Lunch
episodes.summary: The family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner. Grandpa Pig picks some vegetables and Granny Pig makes them into a delicious salad. George doesn't want to eat the salad, but when clever Grandpa Pig makes them into a dinosaur shape George eats up everything on his plate.

episodes.name: Camping
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family go camping. Daddy Pig loves the great outdoors. At bedtime they realise that the tent is too small for them all, but it's not a problem, Daddy Pig likes sleeping under the stars - until it starts to rain.

episodes.name: The Sleepy Princess
episodes.summary: It's bedtime but Peppa isn't at all sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur! The Sleepy Princess falls asleep after a hard day's work and soon, just like the Princess, Peppa and George are sleeping too.

episodes.name: The Tree House
episodes.summary: Grandpa Pig has a big surprise for Peppa and George. He has built them a beautiful tree house in his garden, with cute little curtains on the window. Peppa loves being in the tree house and invites everyone else to come in.

episodes.name: Fancy Dress Party
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are having a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa is dressed as a fairy princess and George is a scary dinosaur. Peppa has to judge the best costume and finds it quite difficult not to pick herself.

episodes.name: The Museum
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family visit the museum. Peppa enjoys the Kings and Queens's room and imagines being a Queen. George's favourite room is the dinosaur room. Daddy's favourite room is the one with the cakes - the museum café!

episodes.name: Very Hot Day
episodes.summary: Today is a very hot day. Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles but the puddles have all dried up. Mummy Pig suggests they put on their swimming costumes and splash about in the paddling pool instead.

episodes.name: Chloé's Puppet Show
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloé. Chloé has a new puppet theatre and she helps Peppa and George to make puppets. After lunch, they put on a puppet show about a pig who snores a lot but Daddy Pig and Uncle Pig miss the show - they're far too busy snoring!

episodes.name: Daddy Gets Fit
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig loves to watch television but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise as his tummy is looking a bit big. Peppa gives him LOTS of exercises to do. Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.

episodes.name: Tidying Up
episodes.summary: Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. Once the room is tidy Mummy says they can go back to their game. The room doesn't stay tidy for long. Peppa's doll and George's dinosaur are at the bottom of the toy box.

episodes.name: The Playground
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are at the playground. Peppa loves to play on the swings but George doesn't like to be pushed too high. Peppa gets stuck in the tyre on the climbing frame and Daddy Pig gets stuck on the slide.

episodes.name: Daddy Puts Up a Picture
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig has a new picture of Peppa and George. Daddy Pig offers to put it up while Mummy is out. The DIY job is not as simple as he thought so Daddy Pig, Peppa and George have to mend the wall before Mummy Pig returns.

episodes.name: At the Beach
episodes.summary: Peppa and George love going to the beach. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand. When it's time to go home, they almost forget Daddy Pig!

episodes.name: Mister Skinnylegs
episodes.summary: George finds a spider in the bathroom sink. When Peppa sees it, is very frightened and screams and runs downstairs to tell Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig. Peppa later realises that it doesn't want to hurt her.

episodes.name: Grandpa Pig's Boat
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with Granny and Grandpa Pig. Danny Dog is sailing too, with Granddad Dog. Grandpa Pig and Granddad Dog are best friends and race to see who has the fastest boat.

episodes.name: Shopping
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family go to the shops for some tomatoes, spaghetti, onions and fruit. George sits in the trolley in the supermarket while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list. Soon, they have everything they need, but Daddy Pig has something that wasn't on the list - a delicious chocolate cake.

episodes.name: My Birthday Party
episodes.summary: It's Peppa Pig's birthday and she wakes up very early - she doesn't waste any of her special day. Peppa gets a present then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear.

episodes.name: Daddy's Movie Camera
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig gets a new movie camera. First, Peppa shows him how to work it, and then he records Peppa saying hello. Everyone laughs when they see Peppa on TV. Peppa, George and Mummy make a movie just for Daddy.

episodes.name: School Play
episodes.summary: Peppa's playgroup is putting on a play. Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig help her to practice her lines. On the night of the play, Peppa and her friends act out the story beautifully.

episodes.name: Bubbles
episodes.summary: George is making bubbles and Peppa is popping them. When the bubble mixture runs out, Daddy Pig shows them how to make really big bubbles then makes a big, muddy, bubbly puddle for everyone to play in.

episodes.name: Emily Elephant
episodes.summary: There's a new pupil today, Emily Elephant. Everyone wants to be her friend because she's good at building blocks and makes a very loud noise with her trunk. Peppa and Emily have something in common: they both muddy puddles.

episodes.name: Polly's Holiday
episodes.summary: Granny and Grandpa's pet, Polly Parrot comes to stay. Peppa and George love her as she's very funny and repeats everything anyone says. When Polly flies away, no one can get her back, until George comes up with a plan. Can George get her back?

episodes.name: Teddy's Day Out
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family are having a picnic and Mr Zebra, the postman and his daughter Zoë Zebra are also having a picnic, so they join up for one big picnic. When it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind. So the Zebras make a special delivery.

episodes.name: Mysteries
episodes.summary: After watching their favourite television programme, 'Detective Potato', Peppa and George are inspired to become famous detectives too. Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve. Teddy is hidden and Peppa and George try to find him.

episodes.name: George's Friend
episodes.summary: Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur but George and Richard are not very good at sharing their toys. Mummy Pig shows George and Richard that they can have much more fun if they play together.

episodes.name: Mr. Scarecrow
episodes.summary: Grandpa is planting seeds for a garden, but the birds keep eating them. Peppa and George help Grandpa to make a scarecrow to stop the birds eating the seeds. Peppa worries that the birds will be hungry.

episodes.name: Windy Autumn Day
episodes.summary: It is a cold and windy day, so Peppa, George, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig wear their hats, scarves and coats to the park. At the park, it is so windy that Peppa's ball blows into the pond and George's hat blows into a tree.

episodes.name: The Time Capsule
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule. The children discover that their parents made a time capsule with Madame Gazelle many, many years ago. And now it is time to open it up.

episodes.name: Rock Pools
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are at the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig. Peppa and George like sandy beaches, but this is a different kind of beach, with lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore. Peppa rescues a little fish and puts it back in the sea.

episodes.name: Recycling
episodes.summary: Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig tells Peppa and George that bottles don't go in the bin, they go into a special green box to be recycled. Old newspapers go in a red box and tins go in a blue box. Peppa and George have fun filling the boxes.

episodes.name: The Boat Pond
episodes.summary: Peppa, her family and friends are playing at the pond with their toy boats. Everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit. Daddy Pig makes Rebecca a very special paper boat out of newspaper.

episodes.name: Traffic Jam
episodes.summary: Granny and Grandpa Pig have invited Peppa and her family to lunch. On the way, Peppa's family get caught in a very long traffic jam.

episodes.name: Bedtime
episodes.summary: It's nearly time for bed. Peppa and George are playing outside when they are called in for their bath. Peppa and George have a bath and brush their teeth so Daddy Pig can read them a story. Soon they are fast asleep. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig finally sit down but they are sleepy too.

episodes.name: Sports Day
episodes.summary: It is Sports Day at Peppa's playgroup and lots of special events, including running, jumping and "tug of war", are due to take place. Daddy Pig tells Peppa that it's not the winning that matters but taking part, but she would really like to win a prize.

episodes.name: The Eye Test
episodes.summary: Peppa's friend, Pedro Pony, wears glasses. Peppa thinks she might need glasses too, so Mummy Pig takes her to visit the optometrist for an eye test. Peppa is disappointed to find she has perfect vision - but that doesn't stop her from wearing some fabulous sunglasses.

episodes.name: Granddad Dog's Garage
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig's car runs out of petrol but thankfully Grandad Dog's garage is not far away. With one phone call, Grandad Dog is on his way and tows Daddy Pig's car back to his garage.

episodes.name: Foggy Day
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are taking Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it gets a bit foggy, and soon it is so foggy they can't see anything. They decide to go home. But which way is home?

episodes.name: Jumble Sale
episodes.summary: Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa, and each of her friends, bring in an old toy but they soon realise that favourite toys can be hard to let go of.

episodes.name: Swimming
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit. Everyone is surprised to discover that Daddy is very good at swimming and diving.

episodes.name: Tiny Creatures
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden. Peppa finds a little snail and Grandpa shows them his beehive. Peppa, George and their friends have fun pretending to be cheeky snails and busy bees.

episodes.name: Daddy Pig's Office
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are visiting Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Daddy works with Mr Rabbit and Mrs Cat. Mr. Rabbit's job is all about numbers, Mrs Cat's job is all about drawing shapes on the computer, and Daddy Pig's job is.. complicated.

episodes.name: Pirate Island
episodes.summary: Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure and they all build a big sandcastle. The children love Pirate Island.

episodes.name: George Catches a Cold
episodes.summary: Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining - but when George takes off his rain hat, he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.

episodes.name: The Balloon Ride
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family go to the school fête. The top prize in the raffle is a trip in a Hot Air Balloon. Peppa wins! Everyone enjoys the flight until the balloon gets caught in a tree. Luckily, it lands in a very familiar garden.

episodes.name: George's Birthday
episodes.summary: Today is George's birthday and Mummy and Daddy Pig have a special day planned. George gets a new Brontosaurus toy and the family go to the museum to see lots of different dinosaurs, including a robot dinosaur that actually moves and roars! The special day ends with a big cake and all of Peppa and George's friends having fun together.

episodes.name: The Long Grass
episodes.summary: The grass is very long. It is so long that when Peppa and George play outside they can't see each other George's ball gets lost in it. The grass is too much for Daddy Pig's rusty old lawnmower so he calls Grandpa Pig for help. Grandpa to save the day with Betsy, his motorised lawnmower.

episodes.name: Zoë Zebra the Postman's Daughter
episodes.summary: Mr. Zebra the Postman is delivering the post and today his daughter Zoë is helping him. Zoë Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa & George; - an invitation to her birthday party.

episodes.name: Painting
episodes.summary: Today Peppa and George are painting. Daddy shows Peppa and George how to mix paints and the three of them paint a beautiful picture of a cherry tree in the garden. Everything is going very well, until the ducks turn up, and runs through the paint - and all over their masterpiece!

episodes.name: Cuckoo Clock
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden cuckoo bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo!', but George wasn't looking and missed the whole thing. George does not want to miss the cuckoo again.

episodes.name: The Baby Piggy
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloé. Today is a special day because Peppa and George are meeting Chloé's new baby brother, Alexander for the first time.

episodes.name: Grandpa's Little Train
episodes.summary: Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude. When he takes Peppa and George for a ride on Gertrude, they meet their friends along the way. There is plenty of room on the train for everyone, so they all hop aboard. Peppa and George think that Gertrude is the very best train in the whole world!

episodes.name: The Cycle Ride
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family go for a day's cycle ride. Peppa rides her little bicycle, while Mummy and Daddy Pig ride their tandem with George on the back. Peppa loves cycling downhill but is not so keen on peddling uphill, so when they meet Peppa's friends and decide to have a race, Peppa insists it should be a downhill race.

episodes.name: Ice Skating
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are going ice-skating today. They have never been ice skating before and Peppa keeps falling over. Daddy Pig tells her not to worry; everyone falls over when they skate for the first time.

episodes.name: The Dentist
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are going to the dentist for a check-up. Peppa and Georges's teeth are lovely and clean and Dr Elephant says their teeth are nice and white but notices that George's plastic toy "Mr Dinosaur's" teeth are a bit yellow and in need of a tooth-clean.

episodes.name: Dens
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are playing in their tree-house. Peppa's friends come to play but Peppa decides that only girls can come into the tree-house, so Grandpa Pig builds the boys their very own den shaped like a castle. When it starts to rain, the boys and girls rush out to play together in the muddy puddles.

episodes.name: Pretend Friend
episodes.summary: Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa cannot see Leo but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and he likes playing dressing up. Peppa decides that now she can see Leo. Even Mummy and Daddy Pig play along with the game. But Peppa's little brother George cannot see Leo and feels a bit left out.

episodes.name: School Bus Trip
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains there is a fantastic view and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.

episodes.name: Rebecca Rabbit
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are going to Rebecca Rabbit's house today. Rebecca's house is a bit different; it is inside a hill and has tunnels instead of stairs and corridors. Peppa and George love Rebecca's house.

episodes.name: Nature Trail
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family go for a walk in the woods and follow a nature trail in the countryside. Peppa and George discover footprints left by little birds and ants. When they get lost they follow their own footprints back to the picnic.

episodes.name: Pen Pal
episodes.summary: Peppa has a new pen pal in France, a little donkey named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.

episodes.name: Granny and Grandpa's Attic
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic. Although the attic is very full, they have trouble deciding what to throw out, because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything. Amongst the clutter, Peppa finds an old record player and some funny old records. The record player still works and soon everyone is dancing.

episodes.name: The Quarrel
episodes.summary: Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends. But one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends anymore. As time goes by they really miss each other but still they refuse to make up. When they finally do, they realise that they will always be best friends.

episodes.name: The Toy Cupboard
episodes.summary: Peppa and George's toy basket is full and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra, the postman, loves assembling flat pack furniture.

episodes.name: School Camp
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire. At bedtime Peppa and her friends get a little scared so they all end up sleeping in Madame Gazelle's tent.

episodes.name: Captain Daddy Pig
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds - Daddy Pig to the rescue!

episodes.name: The Powercut
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family are at home when suddenly go out and Peppa's house is in darkness. There has been a power cut. While the family waits for the electricity to come on again, Peppa and George have fun thinking of games to play in the dark. Peppa makes a pretend television, and enjoys playing with it so much she carries on after the power is restored.

episodes.name: Bouncy Ball
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are playing in the garden with their bouncy ball when Suzy Sheep turns up with two tennis rackets. Suzy uses the bouncy ball to play a game of tennis with Peppa, leaving George feeling a bit left out until he is given the job of "ball boy".

episodes.name: Stars
episodes.summary: It is night time and the sky is fall of shining stars. Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star. The stars are far away and look very tiny. But when Peppa and George look through a telescope the stars look much bigger.

episodes.name: Daddy Pig's Birthday
episodes.summary: Today is Daddy Pig's birthday, but he still has to go to work. While Daddy is away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George make a chocolate birthday cake and prepare a "special birthday surprise". What can Daddy's "special surprise" be?

episodes.name: Sleepover
episodes.summary: Peppa is going for a sleepover at Zoë Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant. The girls are too excited to go to sleep and stay up playing games and having fun until at last they feel sleepy.

episodes.name: Cold Winter Day
episodes.summary: It is a very cold winter day, and Peppa and George head to the park to play. Peppa and George are wearing their hats, scarves, mittens and coats. They want to jump in muddy puddles, but the problem is that the puddles are all frozen over and are slippery, so the two must think of other ways to entertain themselves.

episodes.name: Work and Play
episodes.summary: When Peppa and Suzy learn that grown ups must work all day, they decide to play at working in a shop. But they quickly find it is very tiring.

episodes.name: The Rainbow
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive and they try to find the treasure at the end of it.

episodes.name: Pedro's Cough
episodes.summary: Pedro get a cough at playschool and the other children quickly catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?

episodes.name: The Library
episodes.summary: Peppa wants a new book for bedtime. Mummy Pig looks for a new book and finds Daddy Pig's overdue library book. They go to the library the next day and learn about borrowing books.

episodes.name: The Camper Van
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family go on holiday in a special van, and Peppa is surprised to find that at a push of a button the van turns into a little House for them to sleep in.

episodes.name: Camping Holiday
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family are on holiday in their special camper van. They decide to go to Duck Land, a special park where they can see the ducks in the river, and are surprised when their van turns into a boat.

episodes.name: Compost
episodes.summary: Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Worms inside the bin turn the peelings into compost, which Granny and Grandpa use to help their plants grow.

episodes.name: Richard Rabbit Comes to Play
episodes.summary: Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep comes to play with Peppa. The little boys don't want to play the same games as Peppa and Suzy, so they all play jumping up and down in muddle puddles.

episodes.name: Fun Run
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig struggled to run a race to raise money to fix the school roof, but finds it far easier when a wasp is chasing him.

episodes.name: Washing
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too - which turns Daddy's shirt pink.

episodes.name: Polly's Boat Trip
episodes.summary: Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog, who rescues them in his boat.

episodes.name: Delphine Donkey
episodes.summary: Peppa's French friend Delphine Donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup for a visit, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song', the class' favourite song to sing.

episodes.name: The Fire Engine
episodes.summary: Peppa and George go with Mummy Pig to Miss Rabbit's Mummies Fire Engine Service.

episodes.name: Princess Peppa
episodes.summary: Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig, but Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed, until they are told a story.

episodes.name: Teddy Playgroup
episodes.summary: Peppa brings home a Teddy from Playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he won't have a very exciting time.

episodes.name: Danny's Pirate Party
episodes.summary: It's Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig, the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.

episodes.name: Mr. Potato Comes to Town
episodes.summary: All of the people in Peppa's town are excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre in town.

episodes.name: The Train Ride
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride, where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets. Meanwhile Pedro keeps losing his ticket.

episodes.name: Granny Pig's Chickens
episodes.summary: Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her chickens, whilst something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.

episodes.name: Talent Day
episodes.summary: It is Talent Day at Peppa playgroup, and Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.

episodes.name: A Trip to the Moon
episodes.summary: Peppa's family go to the museum's Moon Exhibition with George's friend Edmond Elephant.

episodes.name: Grandpa at the Playground
episodes.summary: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.

episodes.name: Goldie the Fish
episodes.summary: Goldie the Fish does not look happy and isn't eating her food, so Peppa, George and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the Vet.

episodes.name: Funfair
episodes.summary: The family go to the funfair, but Mummy Pig is angry when people at the fair tell her that she will not be able to win prizes in the competitions.

episodes.name: Numbers
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends learn how to count through playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.

episodes.name: Digging Up the Road
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull and his team are digging up the road.

episodes.name: Freddy Fox
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it's Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

episodes.name: Whistling
episodes.summary: Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.

episodes.name: Doctor Hamster's Tortoise
episodes.summary: Doctor Hamster the vet comes to Peppa's playgroup to show the children her pets. Tiddles the tortoise 'runs' away but Ms. Rabbit rescues him.

episodes.name: Sun, Sea and Snow
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow.

episodes.name: Grandpa Pig's Computer
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig gives her old PC to Granny and Grandpa Pig. Will they be able to use it?

episodes.name: Hospital
episodes.summary: Peppa and her playgroup friends go with Madame Gazelle to visit Pedro Pony, who is in hospital with a broken leg.

episodes.name: Spring
episodes.summary: Grandpa Pig organises a chocolate egg hunt for Peppa and her friends. Will they track down the treats?

episodes.name: Miss Rabbit's Helicopter
episodes.summary: Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and her family for a ride in her rescue helicopter, except Daddy Pig who does not like heights.

episodes.name: Baby Alexander
episodes.summary: Peppa's cousins come to visit, but baby Alexander is too young to talk, until Peppa teaches him his first word.

episodes.name: Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse
episodes.summary: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.

episodes.name: Miss Rabbit's Day Off
episodes.summary: Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket - and everywhere else she works.

episodes.name: The Secret Club
episodes.summary: Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club - going on secret missions, and doing secret things. In secret. But soon everyone wants to join!

episodes.name: Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard
episodes.summary: Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Grandad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.

episodes.name: Shake, Rattle and Bang
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.

episodes.name: Champion Daddy Pig
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper, until everyone helps him train to win it back.

episodes.name: Chatterbox
episodes.summary: Peppa Pig talks far too much. Or at least so Suzy thinks. In response, Peppa decides that she is never going to talk, ever again. But this does not last for very long at all.

episodes.name: Mr. Fox's Van
episodes.summary: When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr. Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van - even a chicken!

episodes.name: Chloé's Big Friends
episodes.summary: Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any "baby" games.

episodes.name: Gym Class
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where at first they think all the stuff to do is scary, but Grampy Rabbit tells the kids about how he explored a jungle, helping the children get over their fears.

episodes.name: The Blackberry Bush
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.

episodes.name: Pottery
episodes.summary: Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoë, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.

episodes.name: Paper Aeroplanes
episodes.summary: Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing, because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes.

episodes.name: Edmond Elephant's Birthday
episodes.summary: It's Edmond Elephant's birthday party and Peppa, Suzy, Danny and Emily are helping out.

episodes.name: The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World
episodes.summary: Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now on an island.

episodes.name: Santa's Grotto
episodes.summary: Peppa and George and their friends go to see Father Christmas. Peppa asks for a very special doll as a present, but will Father Christmas be able to deliver it to her?

episodes.name: Santa's Visit
episodes.summary: Peppa and George wake up very early on Christmas morning. Has Father Christmas delivered the presents they want?

episodes.name: Potato City
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family visit Potato City, a new theme park that has a vegetable theme.

episodes.name: The New House
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are taken to visit the home that Daddy Pig designed and Mr. Bull is building. They are excited to find out who their new neighbors are going to be.

episodes.name: Basketball
episodes.summary: The children are taught how to play basketball by Daddy coach. They are soon good enough to take on a bigger team.

episodes.name: Horsey Twinkle Toes
episodes.summary: There is much excitement when Mr. Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie for Peppa and George.

episodes.name: Naughty Tortoise
episodes.summary: Dr. Hamster's pet tortoise Tiddles gets stuck up a tree again, but the rescue services all have trouble trying to get Tiddles down from the tree.

episodes.name: Mr. Fox's Shop
episodes.summary: Peppa and George visit Mr. Fox's Shop to buy Granny and Grandpa an anniversary present, but they have trouble choosing which one to get.

episodes.name: Shadows
episodes.summary: Peppa and George notice they have shadows, and no matter how fast they walk, run, or jump - they can't lose them.

episodes.name: International Day
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends at playgroup dress up in clothes from different countries all over the world, but they then have an argument.

episodes.name: The Rainy Day Game
episodes.summary: Daddy teaches Peppa and George a fun game to play while they wait inside for the rain to stop.

episodes.name: Mummy Rabbit's Bump
episodes.summary: Everyone is excited when Mummy Rabbit arrives with some big news - she has a big bump in her tummy! Will it be a boy or a girl?

episodes.name: Pedro the Cowboy
episodes.summary: The playgroup is going on a trip to the museum. Everyone, is on the bus ready to go. But where is Pedro Pony?

episodes.name: Peppa and George's Garden
episodes.summary: Grandpa Pig brings some seeds for Peppa and George to grow a garden. Daddy Pig makes himself useful by being the scarecrow.

episodes.name: The Flying Vet
episodes.summary: Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.

episodes.name: Kylie Kangaroo
episodes.summary: Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, but who can jump the highest?

episodes.name: Captain Daddy Dog
episodes.summary: Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited! Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, and he's bearing gifts! What can they be?

episodes.name: Grampy Rabbit's Dinosaur Park
episodes.summary: To celebrate Freddy Fox's birthday, the children go on a trip to a Dinosaur Park. With Grampy Rabbit as their leader, they follow dinosaur footprints to find Freddy's birthday treat.

episodes.name: Bedtime Story
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again, Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep.

episodes.name: Lost Keys
episodes.summary: After a family trip to a mountain beauty spot, Daddy Pig loses the car keys down a very deep drain. Mr. Bull and his road crew dig up the entire beauty spot to retrieve them.

episodes.name: George's New Dinosaur
episodes.summary: George pays a visit to Mr Fox's Shop after his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur breaks. With all the additional features surely Dino Roar is a good replacement?

episodes.name: Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue
episodes.summary: Miss Rabbit's train has broken down with a carriage full of passengers who need to get to work. Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train Gertrude.

episodes.name: The Pet Competition
episodes.summary: Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but finds it hard to choose the best pet.

episodes.name: Spider Web
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig finds a spider in the house and orders Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes, wherever he likes.

episodes.name: The Noisy Night
episodes.summary: Peppa's family are staying at cousin Chloé's house. After a long day everyone is tired and wants to go to sleep. But baby Alexander's crying is keeping everyone awake!

episodes.name: The Wishing Well
episodes.summary: Granny Pig places a large order of plastic gnomes and a wishing well for the garden, Peppa and George love them but Grandpa Pig is not happy. He wishes they would all disappear!

episodes.name: Mr. Potato's Christmas Show
episodes.summary: Hoor-oink! It's Christmas, and Playgroup is going to the theatre to see a special performance. Some people have never been to a theatre before.

episodes.name: Madame Gazelle's Leaving Party
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle announces she is leaving the playgroup. The children are very sad to loose their favourite teacher. And decide to throw her a leaving party.

episodes.name: The Queen
episodes.summary: Miss Rabbit is to be given the Queen's award for Industry, for all the hard work she does. Peppa and her friends accompany Miss Rabbit to the Palace to meet the Queen!

episodes.name: Desert Island
episodes.summary: When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. He soon realises he misses the sea after all.

episodes.name: Perfume
episodes.summary: After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.

episodes.name: The Children's Fete
episodes.summary: The school roof has a leak, again! The children organise a fete to raise money for a new roof.

episodes.name: The Aquarium
episodes.summary: Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium. With all the different fish surely Peppa can find a new friend for Goldie?

episodes.name: George's Racing Car
episodes.summary: Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching motor racing on the television, Granny Pig tells them all to go out and enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.

episodes.name: The Little Boat
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig is left behind when everyone takes Grampy Rabbit's little boat to the riverside picnic spot. Will someone remember him and save him some cake?

episodes.name: The Sandpit
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends are building a desert island, in the sandpit. They add a forest, a lake, houses, and shops. It's all going very well until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up...

episodes.name: Night Animals
episodes.summary: It is night time at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?

episodes.name: Flying on Holiday
episodes.summary: The Pig family are preparing to go on holiday, Peppa and George pack their favourite toys and Granny and Grandpa are left to look after Goldie the Fish.

episodes.name: The Holiday House
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family have landed in Italy, where they discover another spoken language. Daddy Pig finds driving around a little hard. Peppa rings Granny and Grandpa Pig to check are looking after Goldie the Fish.

episodes.name: Holiday in the Sun
episodes.summary: It is the first day in their holiday villa, Peppa and her family go exploring to the local village where there is pizza to eat, presents to buy and a post card to be sent to Goldie the Fish.

episodes.name: The End of the Holiday
episodes.summary: Peppa has enjoyed her holiday abroad, but it is now time to go home. Suzy has missed Peppa very much and can't wait to see her. Peppa can't wait to see Goldie the Fish.

episodes.name: Mirrors
episodes.summary: George enjoys seeing his reflection in the mirror so much that he and Peppa try to find other shiny things to see themselves in.

episodes.name: Pedro is Late
episodes.summary: The playgroup is going on an outing to the museum. Everyone is on the bus ready to go, except Pedro Pony. Where is he?

episodes.name: Garden Games
episodes.summary: Peppa and Suzy are bored because they have nothing to do, so Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with. But not all the games are easy for little George.

episodes.name: Going Boating
episodes.summary: Everyone is down at the lake as it's a perfect day to go boating. Miss Rabbit has all sorts of boats for hire and Daddy Pig picks one with pedals. When all the families have a race, Daddy Pig soon wishes he had picked a boat that was easier to sail and did not have to be pedalled.

episodes.name: Mr. Bull in a China Shop
episodes.summary: While enjoying a tea break, Mr Bull accidentally breaks his delicate teapot. He takes the pieces to Miss Rabbit in the hope that she can mend it.

episodes.name: Fruit
episodes.summary: It is fruit day at the supermarket, and Miss Rabbit is making fruit smoothies. Everyone is picking their favourite fruits to blend. George gets a special 'dinosaur' juice, to make him big and strong. Roar!

episodes.name: George's Balloon
episodes.summary: Peppa and Suzy have nothing to do, and are bored. Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with. But not all the games are easy for little George.

episodes.name: Peppa's Circus
episodes.summary: Grandpa Pig has put up a tent in his garden. Peppa and her friends decide it's a perfect place to put on a circus. With Peppa as the ringmaster, the show can begin!

episodes.name: The Fish Pond
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fish pond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then...

episodes.name: Snowy Mountain
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends are on Snowy Mountain learning how to ski. Their teacher, Madame Gazelle, is very good at skiing and was once a world champion! But in the end it is Mummy Pig who impresses everyone...

episodes.name: Grampy Rabbit in Space
episodes.summary: Grampy Rabbit visits Peppa's playgroup to talk about space rockets. The talk is going very well until suddenly Grampy Rabbit loses his voice. Can Doctor Brown Bear get him talking again?

episodes.name: The Olden Days
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep old photographs from when they were babies. Peppa and Suzy don't remember being that young but are pleased to see that they've always been best friends.

episodes.name: Pirate Treasure
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends are playing pirates. But when they put together a treasure chest and bury it in a marked spot, Pedro soon realises that he needs to follow the trail. He's lost something!

episodes.name: 10 Years of Muddy Puddles: The Golden Boots
Pumpkin Party
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig is throwing a special party. Everyone is invited, and they are all coming dressed in scary costumes. Peppa is a witch, George is a dinosaur, Rebecca Rabbit is a carrot...gone bad!

episodes.name: Around the World with Peppa
episodes.summary: Peppa & her family set off to the park to celebrate the beginning of the summer holidays. But when their car breaks down & Miss Rabbit lends them her plane for the day, they get swept off on an adventure all around the world.

episodes.name: Pretend Playing
episodes.summary: Popular preschool animated series about a lovable piglet and her family. When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles!

episodes.name: The Castle
episodes.summary: Popular preschool animated series about a lovable piglet and her family. Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen and even meet a dragon. It's George's favourite day ever!

episodes.name: Miss Rabbit's Taxi
episodes.summary: Popular preschool animated series about a lovable piglet and her family. Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family in her taxi to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her!

episodes.name: Scooters
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on scooters.

episodes.name: Pumpkin Competition
episodes.summary: It's Halloween and Peppa helps Grandpa Pig carve a pumpkin.

episodes.name: Gerald Giraffe
episodes.summary: Gerald Giraffe is new to the playgroup.

episodes.name: Parachute Jump
episodes.summary: Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump.

episodes.name: Easter Bunny
episodes.summary: Can Peppa and her friends find the chocolate eggs?

episodes.name: Simple Science
episodes.summary: How many children does it take to pick up Madame Gazelle?

episodes.name: School Project
episodes.summary: Mummy and Daddy Pig help Peppa to make her school project.

episodes.name: Mummy Pig's Book
episodes.summary: Peppa and George lose some of Mummy Pig's book.

episodes.name: Grandpa Pig's Greenhouse
episodes.summary: Peppa and George explore salad ingredients in the greenhouse.

episodes.name: Molly Mole
episodes.summary: There is a new girl at school, and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

episodes.name: Move to the Music
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.

episodes.name: London
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle takes the whole class to London for the day where they are given a tour by the Queen herself!

episodes.name: The Police
episodes.summary: When the Police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.

episodes.name: The Zoo
episodes.summary: The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown arond by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.

episodes.name: Canal Boat
episodes.summary: For Captain Daddy Dog's birthday, Mummy Dog surprises him with her present of a boat trip on a 'Canal Boat', which isn't quite what he was expecting.

episodes.name: Australia Part 1 - The Outback
episodes.summary: Peppa, George, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig embark on their first ever Australian holiday.

episodes.name: Australia Part 2 - Surfing
episodes.summary: The Kangaroos take Peppa and her family to the beach on their second day in Australia, where they try surfing for the first time.

episodes.name: Australia Part 3 - The Great Barrier Reef
episodes.summary: Mrs Kangaroo takes everyone on an amazing adventure under the sea in her submarine to see the Great Barrier Reef!

episodes.name: Australia Part 4 - The Boomerang
episodes.summary: Sadly, Peppa and her family's holiday in Australia is coming to an end, but they still have time to play with a boomerang and make friends with Mr Wallaby.

episodes.name: Nursery Rhymes
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery thymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.

episodes.name: Masks
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task - making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks... The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter!

episodes.name: Digger World
episodes.summary: Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to Digger World. They have lots of fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.

episodes.name: The Doll Hospital
episodes.summary: Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital. But she soon realises that she likes Teddy just the way she is.

episodes.name: Wendy Wolf's Birthday
episodes.summary: It's Wendy Wolf's birthday and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party! There are bubbles and balloons to play with - and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf!

episodes.name: George's Woolly Hat
episodes.summary: It's Wendy Wolf's birthday and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party! There are bubbles and balloons to play with - and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf!

episodes.name: Sailing Boat
episodes.summary: Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.

episodes.name: Soft Play
episodes.summary: It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing - soft play! George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups!

episodes.name: The Market
episodes.summary: Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall - he is selling some extra special items!

episodes.name: Father Christmas
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends put on a Christmas show for their parents.

episodes.name: Peppa Goes To Paris
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family travel to Paris to visit Delphine and her relatives

episodes.name: Grandpa Pig's Pond
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are helping Grandpa pig to dig a brand new pond for his garden!

episodes.name: Once Upon a Time
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family go on a walk through the forests where they meet all their favourite fairytale characters.

episodes.name: Police Station
episodes.summary: Oh, no! George has lost Mr Dinosaur! Maybe the police can help George find him.

episodes.name: When I Grow Up
episodes.summary: It's time for playgroup! Today Peppa and her friends are deciding what they might like to be when they grow up.

episodes.name: The Ambulance
episodes.summary: Dr. Brown Bear comes to visit the playgroup and teach all of the children what to do when there's been an accident.

episodes.name: Doctors
episodes.summary: Tiddles the Tortoise gets stuck in a tree and falls onto Pedro Pony's nose when he tries to rescue him! This sets off a chain of events, with visits by Doctor Brown Bear, Doctor Hamster and Doctor Pony to save the day!

episodes.name: Super Potato
episodes.summary: Mr. Potato has come to visit the playgroup and he's brought along his superhero friend, Super Potato!

episodes.name: Grampy Rabbit's Hovercraft
episodes.summary: Grampy Rabbit saves the day when Grandpa Pig's boat sinks and drives everyone around on his hovercraft.

episodes.name: Playgroup Star
episodes.summary: Peppa gets her very first playgroup star in school for drawing a wonderful picture of her house and discovers that Daddy never got a playgroup star when he was young.

episodes.name: The Carnival
episodes.summary: The carnival comes to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things.

episodes.name: Mr. Bull's New Road
episodes.summary: When Peppa takes Goldie the Fish for a visit to the vets, she is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building.

episodes.name: Caves
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family enjoy a day out at the caves, with Grampy Rabbit as their tour guide.

episodes.name: Grandpa's Toy Plane
episodes.summary: Grandpa and Granny Pig share their toys and hobbies with Peppa and George. Granny has a special doll from childhood, but Grandpa builds toy planes.

episodes.name: George's New Clothes
episodes.summary: George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand new clothes; after trying on lots of new exciting outfits, George finds an outfit that suits him just right.

episodes.name: Madame Gazelle's House
episodes.summary: The Peppa family soon realizes that Madame Gazelle's house is being pushed over by a tall tree.

episodes.name: Long Train Journey
episodes.summary: When Daddy Pig receives a letter saying that he must go away on business to test some very important concrete, Peppa, Mummy and George decide to go along too. They all enjoy the very long train journey, snoozing and singing to pass the time.

episodes.name: Suzy Goes Away
episodes.summary: Mummy Sheep learns that she has got a new job, which means moving far away! Peppa and Suzy wonder how they can stay best friends? Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

episodes.name: Tiny Land
episodes.summary: Peppa has a day out with her family and Suzy Sheep, visiting Tiny Land. They see tiny dinosaurs, their favourite tiny landmarks and even a tiny Miss Rabbit doing even more jobs!

episodes.name: Stamps
episodes.summary: Grandpa Pig shows Peppa and George his extensive stamp collection, which inspires them to send a postcard of their own! But when Grandpa gets a very special stamp in the post, he misplaces it. Where can it be?

episodes.name: The Panda Twins
episodes.summary: PC Panda brings his twin daughters, Peggi and Pandora, to playgroup. They love puzzles, and to solve mysteries, just like their dad.

episodes.name: Chinese New Year
episodes.summary: The story revolves around family members demonstrating - through songs and stories - the traditions, crafts, and food of the Chinese New Year to two young siblings.

episodes.name: Mandy Mouse
episodes.summary: Peppa's Playgroup have a new friend to meet - Mandy Mouse. Mandy uses a wheelchair. The children have a lot of fun playing with Mandy as she is super sporty and loves to play games.

episodes.name: Recorders
episodes.summary: The children have a music lesson with Madame Gazelle and all learn how to play the recorder. After lots of practising at home, the children put on a wonderful performance for all the parents to enjoy.

episodes.name: Miss Rabbit's Relaxation Class
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig is persuaded by Miss Rabbit to come along to her relaxation class to help Mummy Pig relax but actual relaxing proves to be more challenging than expected.

episodes.name: Parking Ticket
episodes.summary: When Daddy Pig gets a parking ticket whilst parked in the wrong place, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules too just like children and also get told off too.

episodes.name: Lots of Muddy Puddles
episodes.summary: On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.

episodes.name: Father's Day
episodes.summary: The pre-school adventures of a cheeky and slightly bossy little pig called Peppa, who lives with her mummy and daddy and little brother George. Sometimes these adventures involve a few tears but they always end happily.

episodes.name: Funny Music
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig has a new synthesiser. Peppa, George and Mummy Pig have fun finding and sampling sounds from around the house.

episodes.name: Buttercups, Daisies and Dandelions
episodes.summary: Cousin Chloe, Peppa and George pick flowers making daisy-chains and transforming George into a fearsome dandy-lion.

episodes.name: The Marble Run
episodes.summary: Peppa, George, Rebecca and Richard Rabbit have so much fun playing with the marble run. Though when Daddy Pig joins in, the marble run gets much bigger.

episodes.name: Grandpa Pig's Metal Detector
episodes.summary: When George loses his wind-up robot's metal key, Grandpa Pig uses his metal detector to find it and finds a lot of other things on the way

episodes.name: World Book Day
episodes.summary: It is World Book Day at playgroup but Peppa has so many favourite books she just cannot decide which to go as.

episodes.name: Children's Festival
episodes.summary: The Carnival has come to town and its a chance to see all sorts of exciting things. There is Mr Bulls Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr Potato.

episodes.name: Muddy Festival
episodes.summary: Everyone has fun jumping in muddy puddles and dancing to music at a very muddy festival!

episodes.name: Strawberries
episodes.summary: Peppa goes to a visit to a strawberry farm!

episodes.name: Grandpa Pig's birthday
episodes.summary: It's Grandpa Pig's birthday and the family go out for a celebratory meal. Peppa has never been to a restaurant before.

episodes.name: The Petting Farm
episodes.summary: Peppa and friends visit a Petting Farm where they enjoy feeding chickens and meeting cute and squeaky guinea pigs and they all learn it's important to wash your hands after handling the little animals.

episodes.name: Pizza! Pizza!
episodes.summary: It's almost lunchtime at Peppa Pig's house. Mummy suggest they all make pizza together, they have a lot of fun preparing and mixing up all the food to make their own pizzas - it's all so lovely and messy.

episodes.name: TV Land
episodes.summary: Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made. Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato.

episodes.name: Roman Day
episodes.summary: Granny Pig, Peppa and George have fun dressing up as Romans, making a pebble mosaic of a Dinosaur and learn a little Latin too!

episodes.name: Bird Spotting
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are birdwatching with Grandpa Pig looking for birds and ticking them off in Grandpa pigs book.

episodes.name: Super Potato Movie
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the Super Potato movie.

episodes.name: Bat and Ball
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play bat and ball, she teaches them so well that they beat her at the game and win!

episodes.name: Buried Treasure
episodes.summary: Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox dig a huge tunnel and find a box of pirate treasure and the police seem to be missing their pirate treasure. Something mysterious is going on.

episodes.name: Christmas at the Hospital
episodes.summary: Peppa has to visit the hospital on Christmas Day after she falls over onto her arm, but there is a visit from Santa!

episodes.name: Valentine's Day
episodes.summary: It's Valentine's Day! Daddy Pig gives Mummy Pig a card, but Mummy's card to Daddy hasn't arrived Everyone is sad that Daddy didn't get a card. But when the post finally arrives, there's a big surprise.

episodes.name: The Perfect Day
episodes.summary: While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.

episodes.name: Breakfast Club
episodes.summary: The little piglet and her friends have breakfast together at school, and learn about how food gives them energy.

episodes.name: The Botanical Gardens
episodes.summary: Miss Rabbit shows Peppa's family around the Botanical Gardens.

episodes.name: Mr Potato's Fruit and Vegetable Quiz
episodes.summary: Mr Potato visits the school to talk about fruit and vegetables. But which team will win his quiz?

episodes.name: Viking Day
episodes.summary: Peppa and George join Granny Pig and her friends to play at being Vikings.

episodes.name: Made Up Musical Instruments
episodes.summary: Today at playgroup Peppa and her friends make their own instruments from bits and bobs of old packaging.

episodes.name: In the Future
episodes.summary: Charlotte Sheep is babysitting her cousin Suzy Sheep and her best friend Peppa. Peppa and Suzy are excited at their sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they are all grown up.

episodes.name: Doctor Hamster's Big Present
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. Dr Hamster wishes she could exercise more, so Grampy Rabbit decides to build something to help.

episodes.name: Butterflies
episodes.summary: Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. The children paint caterpillars, make butterfly wings and even dance the life cycle of a butterfly.

episodes.name: Grampy Rabbit's Jetpack
episodes.summary: It's snowing and Grampy Rabbit has built a jetpack. He shoots off into the distance ending up on top of a snowy mountain. Miss Rabbit goes to rescue him, but Grampy Rabbit is the one that rescues them all.

episodes.name: Detective Potato
episodes.summary: Peppa and George go with Daddy Pig to buy some gravel, but on the way back they are unable to find their car in the very large car park.

episodes.name: Electric Car
episodes.summary: Daddy Piggy arrives in a new electric car. The family goes for a ride and are surprised when the car talks and sings.

episodes.name: Jelly
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig shows Peppa and George how to make jelly.

episodes.name: Mr Bull Digs Up the River
Granny Sheep Moves In
episodes.summary: Granny Sheep is moving into Suzy Sheep's house! She is going to stay in the attic. When she arrives, she moves the furniture and replaces different ornaments. Mummy Sheep is very surprised to find everything out of order when she gets home!

episodes.name: Mr Bull Is Getting Married!
episodes.summary: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when everyone finds out that Mr Bull and Mrs Cow are going to get married the next day.

episodes.name: Getting Ready For A Wedding
episodes.summary: Everyone is getting ready for Mr Bull and Mrs Cow's wedding, Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds collect the rings, the wedding dress and the cake.

episodes.name: Wedding Day
episodes.summary: It is the day of Mrs Cow and Mr Bull's wedding but not everything goes to plan, but none of this stops it being the best wedding ever.

episodes.name: Party Bus
episodes.summary: Peppa receives an invite to Candy Cat's birthday party. The party takes place on a double decker bus, which takes them to the playground and the beach.

episodes.name: Movie Night
episodes.summary: Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they watch it, they need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break too.

episodes.name: Art House Day
episodes.summary: Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. Granny Pig finds the perfect art piece at Suzy's house.

episodes.name: Wildflower Wood
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers. The children identify flowers, including wild garlic, bluebells and a rare orchid.

episodes.name: Sunny Day Games
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are playing at their grandparent's garden on a very hot day, Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and a water slide.

episodes.name: Magic Trick
episodes.summary: Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

episodes.name: Jumping Stick
episodes.summary: Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the post and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it but finds it's a lot more difficult now. Peppa and her friends struggle with it.

episodes.name: Racquet Games
episodes.summary: Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. So, the children play badminton instead and it's a lot easier.

episodes.name: Adventure Caravan
episodes.summary: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. But, when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest.

episodes.name: Caravan Friends
episodes.summary: After Peppa and her family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. Luckily, the bear family stop it just in time.

episodes.name: Chloe's Birthday Party
episodes.summary: At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and zips through to reveal the birthday cake!

episodes.name: Broken Party Bus
episodes.summary: Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus - this is a job for Grampy Rabbit! Once fixed, Mummy Rabbit and Rebecca Rabbit arrive with a cake for Grampy Rabbit's birthday!

episodes.name: Living Above the Shops
episodes.summary: Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in an apartment above the shops. Peggi and Pandora Panda, and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

episodes.name: Roof Top Garden
episodes.summary: Peppa and family come to help make a garden on the roof of the apartments. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck!

episodes.name: Moving Day
episodes.summary: Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the apartment. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.

episodes.name: Everybody Sleepover!
episodes.summary: Peppa and all her friends are having a sleepover - different friends in each of the four different apartments in the high street. So they play hide and seek across all the rooms!

episodes.name: Walking Bus
episodes.summary: The children must walk to school in a walking bus! Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.

episodes.name: Happily Ever After
episodes.summary: At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.

episodes.name: Singing Lesson
episodes.summary: Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson, helped by Mummy Rhino on the piano. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song.

episodes.name: Spooky Clubhouse
episodes.summary: The children decorate the clubhouse to make it scary for Halloween... but not too scary. The kids give the grownups a tour of the spooky clubhouse. The grownups pretend to be scared!

episodes.name: Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: Mummy Pig's sister, Aunt Dotty has travelled from far away for Thanksgiving dinner! It's a time to give thanks with those you love and share lots of food. All the family celebrate!

episodes.name: Christmas Cards
episodes.summary: Molly Mole asks if Father Christmas has ever received a Christmas card to say thanks for the presents. Madame Gazelle is horrified to realise they have never given Santa a card!

episodes.name: Larenzo Lion
episodes.summary: Today, Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Larenzo Lion who lives there! Larenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

episodes.name: Dinosaurs Alive!
episodes.summary: The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard! The children all believe it's a dinosaur.

episodes.name: Being Babies
episodes.summary: Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

episodes.name: Mr Cat's Cafe
episodes.summary: Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Cafe. Candy show Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.

episodes.name: Cushion Den
episodes.summary: On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!

episodes.name: Staying Up Late
episodes.summary: Auntie, Uncle Pig and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late - she even stayed up later than the Daddies!

episodes.name: New TV
episodes.summary: Peppa and family are watching TV... until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything... but it doesn't beat their old TV.

episodes.name: Indoor Adventure
episodes.summary: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.

episodes.name: Hot Dry Day
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are playing in their pool. They help the garden animals cool down but when it rains, the animals are happy and so is Peppa. Rain makes muddy puddles for jumping in.

episodes.name: Folk Music Band
episodes.summary: Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's Garden. Granny's friends are playing folk music! They play music for Grandpa Pig and then Grandpa Pig makes apple juice for everyone!

episodes.name: Calling Kylie
episodes.summary: It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn it's not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the earth.

episodes.name: House Rules
episodes.summary: While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.

episodes.name: Big Announcement
episodes.summary: Today is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George. However, Peppa and George struggle to wait patiently, so resort to playing games!
